:::{#def-euclidean-norm}
#### Euclidean norm (length, $L_2$ norm)

The **Euclidean norm**
[@wikipedia_euclidean_vector]
(or **length**, also called the **$L_2$ norm** and written $\norm{\vx}_2$) of a vector $\vx$ of length $p$ is

$$\norm{\vx} \eqdef \sqrt{\vx \cdot \vx} = \sqrt{\sumip x_i^2}$$ {#eq-l2-norm}

where $\sqrt{\cdot}$ is the [square root](algebra.qmd#def-square-root).

:::
